Lockstep release of the nine `@agent-ui-kit/*` packages (shared, icons, a2a, components, data, router, code, a2ui, app). v0.2.0 was tagged on 2026-10-26 but never published: its release workflow failed and npm still served 0.1.0, whose app package depended on an unpublished data package. 0.2.1 is the first publish of the 0.2 line and the first to include `@agent-ui-kit/data`. It carries everything in the v0.2.0 notes (below, with the changes merged since) on top of 0.1.0.

## Breaking changes
- components: the `./components` barrel and `./component-styles.css` exports are gone. Import controls through `./all`, `./all.css`, `./loader`, `./registry` or `./controls/*`; the seam sheet is `./shared-styles.css`. (From 0.1.0.)
- components: `paneResize` and `scrollFade` no longer ride the root barrel. Import them from `@agent-ui-kit/components/traits/pane-resize` and `@agent-ui-kit/components/traits/scroll-fade` (T-0526).
- a2ui: `SHIPPED_PERSONA_CATALOGS` and `SHIPPED_DOMAIN_CATALOGS` no longer come from the root barrel. Import them from `@agent-ui-kit/a2ui/catalogs`; the server-safe `SHIPPED_PERSONA_CATALOG_MANIFESTS` stays on the root (T-0530).
- app: `./agent-admin-roster-source` exports renamed from Persona* to Agent* (`AgentRecord`, `AgentRosterView`, `AgentRosterSource`, `AgentRosterSourceOptions`). (From 0.1.0.)
- a2ui renderer: it applies only props the catalog declares to rendered elements, and resets a mapped prop that a later update drops (T-0552, T-0556). A payload that relied on an undeclared prop reaching the element no longer gets it.
- Media sources (ui-image, ui-avatar, ui-video, ui-audio, ui-product-card image) accept only http, https, data and blob sources; anything else renders no media (T-0553).

## New subpaths
- components: `./traits/roving-focus` (T-0521), `./traits/pane-resize` and `./traits/scroll-fade` (T-0526).
- a2ui: `./catalogs` (T-0530).

## Notes for upgraders
- Install `@agent-ui-kit/*` at 0.2.1, not 0.2.0. There is no 0.2.0 on npm.
- Controls take the ADR-0245 derived foundations; ui-icon's old `glyph` prop and the `[scale]` / `[density]` attributes still work as bridges and are slated for removal in a later release (T-0353).

## Added
- data: first publish of `@agent-ui-kit/data`, the headless data layer (`DataSource<T>`, `resource()`, `mutation()`, `paginated()`, `./gateway`, `./stream`) that `@agent-ui-kit/app` depends on. The release now publishes data before app (T-0489).
- shared: `./foundations.css` and `./foundations-bridge.css`, the derived geometry and type foundations (ADR-0245), with density moving the control ramp.
- components: generated `./all`, `./all.css`, `./registry` and `./loader` entry points (ADR-0233).
- components: a bare ui-nav-rail is one tab stop with vertical arrow roving (T-0521).
- a2ui: the selection and commit patterns (OptionDeck, OptionCompare, ConfirmReceipt, AmountPicker, StepFlow, Itinerary) in the producer stack; `./registry`, `./agent/model-capabilities` and `./agent/agent-bundle`; the `./agent` producer toolkit ships its prompts and sidecars embedded and imports from plain Node (ADR-0236).
- a2ui: catalog media props declare a media URL format that the validator checks (T-0563); semantic checks flag inert Basic props and a receipt total label without a path (T-0556); a cart or order ConfirmReceipt whose quantity no AmountPicker binds is sent back with a repair (T-0550).
- app: agent-admin overlay, value-digest, content-fields and compile modules.
- Every package declares `sideEffects`, so bundlers can tree-shake unused modules.

## Changed
- Smaller imports: the components root barrel is 805 B gz lighter (T-0526), ui-text-field loads its `type=color` codec only on first use (1169 B gz off every plain text field, T-0527), and the a2ui root no longer pulls the shipped catalogs (T-0530).
- Hardening: stricter checks on payload regular expressions, frame messaging, the dev proxy and the worker, with a trust note for custom icon packs (T-0544, T-0552, T-0553, T-0554, T-0556).
- RTL: slider, slider-multi, overlay placement, calendar and board-grid arrows, directional glyphs, the disclosure chevron, drill slides, the conversation-composer popups, rating, amount-picker and list-reorder follow `dir=rtl` (T-0538, T-0539, T-0561, T-0540).
- Accessibility: placeholders, links and secondary text in nav-rail, calendar, toggle and option-compare meet AA in light and dark; pagination marks the current page in forced colors; split separators announce their orientation; ui-list children carry listitem semantics; an unlabelled table region is not a nameless tab stop; modal and drawer forward late accessible names (T-0519, T-0520, T-0518, T-0557, T-0558, T-0560).
- Lifecycle: a reconnected ui-status-stream resumes ticking, overlay controls removed while open end closed and emit `close`, and timers and deferred turns stop acting on a detached host (T-0541, T-0542).
- Theme: dead color fallbacks removed and one shared overlay shadow token (T-0559).
- a2ui-basic factories honor upstream defaults on omitted props, and TextField `longText` is multi-line (T-0555).
- Producer repairs: an empty round after a forced or semantic repair re-sends that repair ask, a component moved to a new parent in one `updateComponents` batch survives the merge, and a malformed messages string missing or carrying a surplus closer is closed in place (T-0469, T-0498, T-0499, T-0501).
- Consumer CSS recipes and package READMEs load all four foundation sheets and list every export (T-0490).

Changes up to and including PR #2367. Full list of merged changes: https://github.com/kimgranlund/agent-ui/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged
